text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Verxina-chan. Heading out 
somewhere today?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, it's a rare day off with no plans, so 
I thought I'd do some solo training I'd 
been planning for a while.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, an ice cream shop has opened in 
front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The #1 most popular item is the 
Extra-Rich Strawberry Milk Ice Cream. The 
refreshing tartness and rich milk blend in 
exquisite harmony"—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should go buy some after 
independent practice. I'll get enough for 
Cheval and Verxina for snack time—

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"That shop over there is super popular. 
Especially on weekends, they sell out in a 
flash...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is it... that much? Especially when you're 
the number one favorite...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...In that case!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, but the Extra Rich 
Strawberry Milk Ice Cream is completely 
sold out!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ……A-Already……!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(No way... I came all the way out here, 
even sacrificing my self-training to stop 
this from happening...)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like our second most popular 
item, the banana ice cream, we still have 
plenty in stock!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Number two...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, regarding this shop, do you 
have any other branch locations?"

text_block_list.name: Clerk from Another Store
text_block_list.text: It just sold out right now! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that is how it is. The number 
one favorite is, once again...

text_block_list.name: Clerk from Another Store
text_block_list.text:
If it's the second most popular banana ice 
cream, we still have plenty available!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Kh...!! No, it's fine. I'll just look 
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Shop No. 3 Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It's sold out... However, this banana ice 
cream is quite popular—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Number two, right? Well, that just won't 
do...!

text_block_list.name: Shop No. 11 Clerk
text_block_list.text: Excuse me... In exchange—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Number two can never replace number 
one...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Why is it always number 2...?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Not yet...! I'm not gonna settle for 
second place...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I spotted Verxina and the 
others chatting in the academy's 
courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ so yummy~~! It's so sweet and 
milky~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“These usually sell out super fast though! 
Big sis, you really are the best~♪”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I suppose I was just lucky to be 
able to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sis, are you finished eating already? 
Were you really hungry? Want half of mine?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! N-No, um... it was just so delicious 
I couldn't help myself...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, how about you, Cheval? 
Is it good?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, it's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Big sis... never compromises, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her younger sisters also looked delighted 
with the snacks Verxina bought for them.

big sister is.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even in the smallest of things, the state 
of one's mind will show through, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up, no matter what happens— I 
have to keep going with that attitude, 
fufu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I wonder if the results of my 
daily training are starting to show..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to keep working hard so I can 
stay number one... and seize first place, 
hehe.
